title: Advertising: Main Exam, 9 December 2019
department: Department of Journalism and Mass Communication
programme: Bachelor of Arts in Mass Media and Communication
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE (COMPULSORY) AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS.

parts.text: Define the following concepts as used in advertising.
Describe any five guidelines for creating an advertisement.
Classify the advertising agencies used in advertising.
Explain the purpose of advertising in society.
Describe direct mail advertising and its characteristics.
Differentiate above-the-line advertising from below-the-line advertising.
Explore the advantages of print media to advertising.

items.text: Discuss the factors to consider when choosing a medium for advertising.

parts.text: Elaborate on the guidelines for creating effective advertising.
Analyse the formats for commercials common for radio or television advertising.

programmes: Bachelor of Arts in Mass Media and Communication
